goals.title: Goals
goals.subtitle: Break what you want to achieve into milestones, and confirm each one as you reach it

create.namePlaceholder: e.g. Pass the Fundamental IT Engineer exam
create.descriptionPlaceholder: What has to be true to call it achieved (optional)

empty.title: No goals yet
empty.description: Write down one thing you want to achieve, then break it into milestones

milestone.title: Milestones
milestone.empty: No milestones yet. Add the first one

criteria.title: Done when
criteria.none: No criteria yet. Decide what has to be true for this milestone to count as reached
criteria.placeholder: e.g. 70%+ on past morning papers three times in a row

confirm.title: Confirm "{name}" as reached
confirm.lead: Check each criterion once you have made sure it is met. Finishing every task is not enough if a criterion is not met.
confirm.evidencePlaceholder: e.g. 74% on the morning section of the Nov 10 mock exam; finished the 2023–2025 past papers

goals.deleteConfirm: Delete this milestone? Its tasks are kept and simply leave the milestone.

unassigned.title: Tasks not in a milestone ({count})
unassigned.description: File each task under the milestone it works towards to see each milestone's progress
